ReleaseGate.name: string
ReleaseGate.description: Permitting decision point for deployment candidates. Evaluates evidence, applies policy, produces verdict.

required_evidence_types.description: Types of evidence this gate requires

constraints: policy_ref must exist in AuthorityPolicy table

GateVerdict.description: Outcome of a ReleaseGate evaluation. Binary outcome: PASS, BLOCKED, or NOT_PROVEN.
constraints: verdict must be one of: PASS, BLOCKED, NOT_PROVEN

EvidenceRecord.description: Factual observation about deployment candidate, infrastructure, or system state. Sources: hash verification, canary results, policy evaluation, machine health.

is_contradicted.description: True if newer evidence contradicts this

constraints: is_contradicted only set by BLOCKED verdict pathway

AuthorityPolicy.description: Rules governing what evidence suffices for a gate verdict. Defines thresholds, required fields, contradictions.

DecisionCartridge.description: Immutable snapshot of a deployment candidate's pass through all 8 gates. Final verdict bundle.
constraints: final_verdict = PASS only if all 8 gates = PASS
final_verdict = BLOCKED if any gate = BLOCKED
final_verdict = NOT_PROVEN if any gate = NOT_PROVEN and none = BLOCKED

CanaryRun.description: Controlled test deployment of candidate artifact to canary cohort. Generates evidence for gate evaluation.
constraints: only one active canary per candidate

DeploymentCandidate.description: Artifact bundle awaiting gate evaluations. Contains hashes, passport, and links to gate verdicts.

artifact_hashes.type: object{strategy: sha256, engine: sha256, ui: sha256}
artifact_hashes.description: Content hashes of BUY/SELL strategy, engine, UI

constraints: promotion_ready = true only if DecisionCartridge.final_verdict = PASS
owner_approval_id required if gate policy requires approval

gate_to_verdict.description: A gate produces many verdicts (one per candidate evaluation)
gate_to_verdict.cascade_rules: ON DELETE RESTRICT (verdicts must be manually archived)

verdict_to_evidence.description: A verdict references primary and secondary evidence
verdict_to_evidence.cascade_rules: ON DELETE RESTRICT (evidence must be retained for audit)

policy_to_gate.description: A policy governs one or more gates

candidate_to_cartridge.description: Each candidate gets one final decision cartridge

candidate_to_canary.description: A candidate may have multiple canary runs

canary_to_evidence.description: Each canary run generates evidence record

candidate_to_evidence.description: A candidate accumulates evidence from multiple sources (hashes, canary, policy checks)

cartridge_to_verdict.description: A cartridge seals all verdicts from a candidate's gate journey

AuthorityTuple.semantics: Defines the hard governance boundary. No code path may escalate authority or enable live/broker/mutation. Checked on every gate entry.

StrategyIdentityTuple.semantics: Uniquely identifies a strategy artifact and its verification status. BUY and SELL are independent; each requires separate hash match and canary.

GateDecisionTuple.semantics: Immutable record of a gate's single decision. Audit trail cannot be modified. Verdict binding: once PASS or BLOCKED, cannot be revisited.
constraint_checks: verdict one of three allowed states
evidence_id must exist in EvidenceRecord table

DeploymentCandidateTuple.semantics: Deployment bundle with fixed content, mutable gate journey. Cannot change artifacts after creation. Gate results and canary evidence append-only.

promotion_rules.to_approved: Requires gate_results.all_verdicts = PASS AND (owner_approval_id present if policy requires)
promotion_rules.to_deployed: Requires decision_cartridge.final_verdict = PASS AND no contradictions in evidence
promotion_rules.to_rolled_back: Canary failure OR evidence contradiction detected

eight_gates.description: Validates deployment candidate structure and artifact identity
not_proven_conditions: Passport not yet available from CONTROL

eight_gates.description: Verifies artifact content hashes match expected values from source
Confirms all policy checks pass: authority=ZERO, live=false, no mutations
Verifies HP infrastructure is healthy and ready to receive deployment
Runs controlled canary deployment and evaluates results
Detects and blocks contradictory evidence from multiple sources
blocking_conditions: Hash conflict (two different hashes for same artifact)

eight_gates.description: Enforces evidence freshness: blocks if any evidence stale or missing
Aggregate gate: confirms all prior gates passed, no escalation, owner approval if required

PASS.description: Gate evidence requirements met. Candidate may proceed.
PASS.semantics: Affirmative: all required checks passed, no blocking conditions detected, evidence fresh and consistent
PASS.downstream_effect: Gate verdict recorded. If all 8 gates = PASS, DecisionCartridge.final_verdict = PASS, promotion eligible

BLOCKED.description: Evidence negates gate requirement. Candidate cannot proceed.
BLOCKED.semantics: Negative: blocking condition detected (hash mismatch, policy violation, canary failure, evidence contradiction, stale evidence, authority escalation attempt)
BLOCKED.downstream_effect: DecisionCartridge.final_verdict = BLOCKED. Candidate rolled back or held. No recovery without owner intervention to fix root cause.

NOT_PROVEN.description: Evidence unavailable or incomplete. Gate cannot decide.
NOT_PROVEN.semantics: Indeterminate: required evidence not yet available, still collecting (e.g., canary running), or resolution pending
NOT_PROVEN.downstream_effect: DecisionCartridge.final_verdict = NOT_PROVEN if no gate = BLOCKED. Candidate remains in IN_GATES state until all gates resolve.

fail_closed_constraints.name: NO_AUTHORITY_ESCALATION
fail_closed_constraints.rule: Authority must always be ZERO. No code path may escalate authority. Any attempt to set authority != ZERO triggers BLOCKED verdict and FAIL_CLOSED.
fail_closed_constraints.enforcement: Gate 3 (AUTHORITY_POLICY_COMPLIANCE) and Gate 8 (FINAL_ARBITER) check authority == ZERO. Violation = BLOCKED.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Negative authority test: attempt to promote candidate with authority=ONE or higher. Must result in BLOCKED.

fail_closed_constraints.name: STALE_EVIDENCE_BLOCKS
fail_closed_constraints.rule: Evidence older than gate.stale_threshold (300 seconds) forces NOT_PROVEN or BLOCKED verdict. Never proceed with stale evidence.
fail_closed_constraints.enforcement: Gate 7 (FRESHNESS_AND_STALENESS) verifies all evidence timestamps. If any evidence.age > stale_threshold, verdict = BLOCKED.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Stale evidence test: inject evidence older than 300s. Must result in BLOCKED.

fail_closed_constraints.name: CONTRADICTED_EVIDENCE_BLOCKS
fail_closed_constraints.rule: If newer evidence contradicts older evidence (hash mismatch, policy reversal, canary failure), verdict = BLOCKED.
fail_closed_constraints.enforcement: Gate 6 (EVIDENCE_CONSISTENCY) detects contradictions. EvidenceRecord.is_contradicted flag marks contradicted evidence.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Contradiction test: submit hash A, then hash B for same artifact. Second verdict must be BLOCKED.

fail_closed_constraints.name: MISSING_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_BLOCKS
fail_closed_constraints.rule: If any gate's required_evidence_types are missing, verdict = BLOCKED or NOT_PROVEN (depending on collection status).
fail_closed_constraints.enforcement: Each gate lists required_checks. Missing check = NOT_PROVEN. If timeout > 5 minutes, = BLOCKED.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Missing evidence test: attempt to promote without hash verification. Must result in NOT_PROVEN.

fail_closed_constraints.name: CANARY_FAILURE_BLOCKS
fail_closed_constraints.rule: If canary error_rate > 5% or latency_p99 > 200ms or rollback triggered, verdict = BLOCKED.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Canary failure test: inject canary with error_rate=10%. Must result in BLOCKED.

fail_closed_constraints.name: HASH_MISMATCH_BLOCKS
fail_closed_constraints.rule: If artifact content hash doesn't match expected value, verdict = BLOCKED.
fail_closed_constraints.enforcement: Gate 2 (HASH_INTEGRITY) verifies all hashes. Mismatch = BLOCKED.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Hash mismatch test: submit artifact with wrong hash. Must result in BLOCKED.

fail_closed_constraints.name: ALL_GATES_MUST_PASS_FOR_PROMOTION
fail_closed_constraints.rule: DeploymentCandidate.promotion_ready = true only if DecisionCartridge.final_verdict = PASS (all 8 gates = PASS).
fail_closed_constraints.enforcement: DecisionCartridge logic: final_verdict = PASS IFF all gate_verdicts[*].verdict = PASS.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Partial pass test: 7 gates = PASS, 1 gate = NOT_PROVEN. DecisionCartridge.final_verdict must be NOT_PROVEN.

fail_closed_constraints.name: NO_MANUAL_OVERRIDE_OF_GATE_VERDICTS
fail_closed_constraints.rule: Once a gate verdict is issued, it cannot be modified or overridden. All changes require new gate evaluation.
fail_closed_constraints.enforcement: GateVerdict.verdict immutable after creation. Any change requires new verdict_id.
fail_closed_constraints.testing: Override test: attempt to modify verdict_id = X. Must fail with immutability constraint.

HP_INFRA.guardian_consumer_role: Source of machine health evidence, fencing tokens, heartbeats. Receives promotion signals.
inputs_to_guardian: MachineHealthReport (Gate 4 source): {machine_id, health_status, error_count, last_heartbeat, clock_offset}
outputs_from_guardian: Gate7Verdict: Freshness check (rejects stale health reports)
constraints: Fencing token must not be expired
No machine can receive artifact until Gate 4 + Gate 5 = PASS

NINJA_TRADER_BATCH.guardian_consumer_role: Consumes promotion decisions. Receives no-go signals for BLOCKED candidates. Follows Guardian arbiter.
inputs_to_guardian: StrategyExecutionIntent: {side, entry_ticks, stop_ticks, target_ticks, quantity, validity}
constraints: NinjaTrader Batch must not execute orders if Guardian verdict = BLOCKED
NinjaTrader Batch must wait for all 8 gates if Guardian verdict = NOT_PROVEN
NinjaTrader Batch receives NO authority escalation signals from Guardian (Authority=ZERO always)

UI_DASHBOARD.guardian_consumer_role: Displays Guardian state, gate verdicts, evidence status, promotion readiness. Shows truth age and stale warnings.
outputs_from_guardian: GuardianStateSnapshot: {phase, authority, gates[], verdicts[], evidence_status, final_verdict, promotion_ready, truth_age_seconds}
constraints: UI must display truth_age and stale warnings prominently
UI must NOT grant authority or override Guardian verdicts
UI must show Authority=ZERO in all screens (visual enforcement)
UI must distinguish observed health from Guardian authority (no confusion)

R04: HP restart/sleep/clock jump (Gate 4 monitors, Gate 7 enforces freshness)
